# Select

## Purpose and role

A closed field that opens a list of options to choose one.

Role: `combobox (select-only)`.

## Keyboard

| Key (Desktop) | Key (Vim) | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter Space` | `Enter Space` | Open |
| `↑↓` | `↑↓` | Move |
| `PgUp PgDn` | `PgUp PgDn` | Page |
| `Home End` | `g G` | First / last |
| `a–z` | — | Jump to a row by name |
| `Esc` | `Esc` | Close |

## Mouse

| Target | Click | Double click | Secondary click | Drag | Wheel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| field | opens or closes the list | — | — | — | — |
| option | chooses it and closes | — | — | — | scrolls the options |

## Hints by state

| State | Desktop | Vim |
|---|---|---|
| closed | `Enter` Open | `Enter` Open |
| open | `↑↓` Move · `Type` to jump · `Enter` Choose · `Esc` Close | `↑↓` Move · `Enter` Choose · `Esc` Close |

## Knobs

| Knob | Default | Layer | Standard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nav` | the NavProfile's keys (Desktop: arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) | profile | APG keyboard interaction |
| `type_ahead` | on under Desktop, off under Vim | profile | APG type-ahead; WCAG 2.1.4 |
| `dismiss` | Esc and an outside click close the list | widget | APG combobox |

## Keyboard-only path

- Open: `Enter Space`
- Move: `↑↓`
- Page: `PgUp PgDn`
- First / last: `Home End`
- Jump to a row by name: `a–z`
- Close: `Esc`

## Mouse-first path

- field: click opens or closes the list; double click —; wheel —.
- option: click chooses it and closes; double click —; wheel scrolls the options.
